title: I thought I was alone for decades.
content: Wow, hello all! I had no idea the things I have experienced in my dreams/night terrors are a shared experience. I have discussed my dreams with people IRL and no one has had a similar experience. I guess some background, recently found out about “GATE” programs. I do not recall being in one full time but in middle school I was definitely pulled out of class and was in a room with other students doing random tests (I seriously don’t remember any of it). I find myself pretty sensitive to energies/paranormal feelings as I have lived in very historic homes and locations. I have had sleep paralysis throughout my life, but it really was consistent once in college and in post grad school. I don’t have it as much anymore; however, I do dream nightly and basically remember everything and am completely aware that I am dreaming. My dreams are usually at the same locations and I always recognize them for past dreams: airports, resort/hotel, casino-like-mall, and schools I have attended (elementary, middle school, and high school). I won’t go into details on airport/hotel/casino/mall, but my most reoccurring is high school. Sometimes all three schools blend, but most common, it is my high school. In my high school dreams, I am late, do not know what my schedule is, cannot find the right book in my locker, and constantly trying to find the right elevator or stairway to get back to the correct hallway. The most common thing IS THE BATHROOMS AND LOCKER ROOM. No privacy, people are mean/rude, no doors. Often times toilets are facing each other. When I’m in a locker room it goes on forever with huge showers and toilets. Usually a bluish green tile, pretty wet. It is also somewhat bifurcated between a men area and woman area. But one weird turn I would accidentally end up in the men’s room. And yes, they are always dirty and I’m often trying to clean them? Not sure why I’m posting this. I guess this is just cathartic for me to finally know that others experience this. Happy dreaming!
